sources.title: Quick Start Demo | 1184110286/NeuralLog | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page provides a step-by-step walkthrough of the complete NeuralLog demo workflow, including dataset preparation and running the BGL anomaly detection example. The demo demonstrates the core functionality by processing raw log files, extracting semantic vectors using BERT encoding, and training a transformer-based classification model.
